Orbit Workspace Security & Compliance Policy:
- Session timeout is enforced at exactly 15 minutes of inactivity.
- Two-factor authentication (2FA) is mandatory for all members with administrative roles.
- Passwords must contain a minimum of 12 characters including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.
- Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) strictly prohibits wildcard origins in production environments.

Orbit Backend Architecture Specification:
- The backend API runs on port 8000 using FastAPI.
- The frontend web client runs on port 3000 using Next.js.
- Redis caching is deployed on port 6379 for real-time pub/sub and distributed rate limiting.
- Distributed rate limiting is enforced at 50 requests per minute per IP address.
- The database connection pool maintains 30 persistent connections with an overflow limit of 20 connections.
- SSL/TLS encryption is strictly enforced for all public HTTP and WebSocket traffic.
